Elise v1.0.7 fixes REALITY startup-probe warnings seen with V2Board protocol nodes.

- Bare REALITY destination hostnames now use the configured TLS server port or 443. Explicit destination ports remain unchanged; IPv4 and IPv6 are supported. Invalid destinations fail during configuration loading instead of on a later fallback connection.
- Connect-only health checks close cleanly without triggering a REALITY fallback. Partial non-TLS headers are forwarded without added zero bytes.
- Per-connection Vision timing messages now use debug level to keep normal info logs quiet.

Upgrade:

```bash
sudo elisectl update
elise --version
```

Updating briefly interrupts connections on active nodes. No panel adapter change is needed for this fix. For v1.0.6 installations awaiting upgrade, an explicit destination such as `visualstudio.microsoft.com:443` avoids the missing-port error.

See the [latest-install instructions](https://github.com/phungvanquy/elise/blob/v1.0.7/README.md#installation). Both Linux amd64 and arm64 archives include matching installation tools and SHA-256 checksums.
